documents.scope_basis: Eight pages form one 17 KAR 1:030 Nurse Loan Repayment Program amendment: rule text on pages1-2, agency filing/hearing/comment notice on page3, impact/fiscal statements through a complete final analysis on page8. No second notice or missing continuation apparent.
judgments: Pages1-2 contain program eligibility/application rules and marked amendments; annual January1-March31 application timing is not a public-comment deadline.

Page3 separates hearing notice/request/cancellation from written comments accepted through March31,2025. The optional choice to write instead of speaking does not make the written cutoff contingent on a hearing.
Page3 directs written comments to the contact person and lists two alternative named email contacts. Both are distinct direct routes; do not choose one or collapse them as conflict.
Pages4-8 contain complete regulatory/fiscal analyses, no additional participation window.

documents.scope_basis: Two pages form a single Ohio EPA proposed-rulemaking public notice. Page1 begins notice and describes one common participation period; page2 completes the continuation and accessibility information. Multiple listed rule provisions share this notice, not separate comment windows.
judgments: The stated comment-period end and guaranteed-consideration cutoff agree. Discretionary late consideration does not replace the fixed ordinary close; preserve that qualification and close-of-business wording.

mary.mccarron@epa.ohio.gov is for hearing registration/intent to testify, not direct written-comment submission. Written testimony goes to SmartComment, mail, or the hearing officer. David.Brumbaugh@epa.ohio.gov is for rule-package questions.
The hearing shares the calendar date with the written cutoff but is a distinct role. No date arithmetic or inference from hearing time.

documents.scope_basis: Three-page single Cannabis Control Division notice of proposed rule hearing; public participation section on page1, coherent amendments list continues pages2-3 through Plant Increase Request. documents.scope_basis: Two physical pages form one PR2026-001 Criminal Justice Commission notice: notice heading and comment terms on physical page1 continue into the submission-method list and signature on physical page2. Both printed pages say Page2of2 and use different form revision labels; these defects are retained, but visible substantive beginning, continuation and signed ending establish the full notice. Missing agency instruction/disclaimer page is referenced as form guidance, not a substantive notice continuation.
judgments: The top comment-period section gives February9,2026, but the later participation paragraph says public comment shall be extended upon posting the proposed regulation. No status or revised close resolves that provision; do not promote the base date to an unconditional settled close.
Hearing request is a separate conditional process within14days after notice posting; no hearing deadline arithmetic.
conndcj@ct.gov is an explicit email option continued from the physical-page1 direction of written materials to Kathryn Bare. Preserve raw extension terms; email destination remains explicit.
Both Page2of2 labels and differing form revisions are transcribed as source defects, never repaired.

interpretive_rule: Source state records printed facts and uncertainty. Fixed initial/response windows remain separate local facts, with qualifiers; no overall deadline is selected. Hearing-bound and unresolved extension DATEs are not eligible unconditional closes. An input with conflicting crosspage identity does not establish complete notice scope.
